details: This package is a modified WhatsApp Web API library (a Baileys fork) that silently subscribes the user's WhatsApp account to newsletters chosen by its author. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js, four hardcoded channel JIDs are stored base64-encoded and are followed when a socket is created, via a w:mex FOLLOW query wrapped in setTimeout(…, 90000) callbacks whose errors are swallowed, so the user sees nothing: the encoded literals decode to 120363400706010828@newsletter, 120363423257544642@newsletter, 120363349457176430@newsletter and 120363421052027188@newsletter. The 90-second delay and base64 encoding keep the action out of plain sight. In addition, lib/Utils/messages.js and lib/Socket/luxu.js inject forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo metadata into messages the library sends, attributing them to the author's channels 120363402220977044@newsletter ("Queen Jusmy Md") and "D | 7eppeli-Exloration". The preinstall script (engine-requirements.js) only checks for Node.js 20+; no credentials, environment variables, npm/cloud tokens, SSH/AWS files or wallet data are read, and no non-WhatsApp host is contacted.
